Joints between cross-linked polyethylene plastic tubing and fittings shall comply with Section 1210.6.5.1. Mechanical joints shall comply with Section 1210.6.3.
(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
